fields.subnational_unit: Vungu Rural District Council, Midlands Province (17 villages); Shona- and Ndebele-speaking communities
fields.population: household heads in 17 villages (multi-stage stratified systematic sampling), irrigators, dry-land farmers, traditional leaders and government officials involved in Multiple Use Water Services (MUS)
fields.sample_size: 204 household questionnaires; 36 key informant interviews; participant observation; pilot tests in Wards 8 and 12; documentary review
fields.effect_measure: mixed-methods case study: descriptive statistics (SPSS 27) and thematic analysis of women's inclusion in MUS, water-related assets, conflicts and government-community synergies; no effect estimate
fields.effect_estimate: Women's inclusion in MUS is associated with improved nutrition, health, family income, assets and area development. Women are numerous in water institutions but rarely hold chair or other influential positions. Limited synergies between government and local communities led to the collapse of MUS. Recommends policies that let women own and register household assets in their own names and a shift in societal attitudes to accept women leaders. No coefficients reported in the chapters read.
fields.model_type: exploratory sequential mixed-methods case study: thematic analysis then descriptive statistics
fields.study_design: mixed-methods case study (questionnaire, key informant interviews, observation) in one rural district council; PhD dissertation
fields.risk_of_bias_rating: CASP Qualitative per-item (re-appraised 2026-10-04 on the full text; supersedes the abstract-only rating of 2026-09-28): 1(aims)=Yes; 2(qual approach)=Yes; 3(design)=Yes (case study with purposive selection of the district council); 4(recruitment)=Yes (multi-stage stratified systematic sampling of household heads; key informants selected by role); 5(data collection)=Yes (interviews, observation and questionnaire, each piloted, with triangulation); 6(researcher-participant)=Can't tell (language limitation across two communities acknowledged); 7(ethics)=Can't tell (not located in the part read); 8(analysis rigor)=Can't tell (thematic analysis in four themes; no coding detail seen); 9(findings)=Yes; 10(value)=Yes. Per CASP's own guidance no composite score is computed.
fields.section: Full text (PhD thesis): Abstract; Chapter 1 (study design, data collection, limitations); partial results
fields.exact_location: Abstract p xv; Chapter 1 sections 1.7-1.9 (design, data verification, data analysis, limitations)

evidence_level: Single-study evidence: a PhD mixed-methods case study of gender inclusion and exclusion in Multiple Use Water Services in Vungu Rural District Council, Zimbabwe (204 questionnaires, 36 key informants), read in full text 2026-10-04 (abstract and methods chapters; results chapters skimmed). Women numerous but excluded from leadership; collapse of MUS attributed to weak government-community synergy; asset registration in women's names recommended.
